title: Paradise, Human Creation, and Noah's Call

paragraphs.text: These believers are the heirs who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will stay there forever.

Allah created man from an extract of clay. Then He placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place. He made the drop into a clinging clot, and the clot into a lump of flesh. From the lump He made bones and covered them with flesh. Then He made him into another creation. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators. After that, you will die, and on the Day of Resurrection you will be raised.

Above you Allah made seven heavens, and He is never unaware of His creation. He sends rain from the sky in measure and keeps it in the earth. He could also take it away. With it He grows gardens of palm trees and grapes with many fruits. He also grows a tree from Mount Sinai that gives oil and food. In livestock there is a lesson. You drink from them, eat from them and get many benefits. You ride on them and on ships.

Allah sent Noah to his people. He told them to worship Allah alone and fear Him. But their leaders said he was only a man like them who wanted to be above them. They said Allah would have sent angels instead. They called him mad and told people to wait. Noah asked his Lord for help because they denied him.
